notes: BM25 retrieval quality over the full SciFact dev set, using the production ranker's tokenizer, corpus IDF, and K1/B constants. Fully deterministic (fixed corpus, no LLM), so floors are pinned to the observed values with only a float-rounding tolerance: the previous floors sat ~2 points below observed and let recall@10 fall from 0.916 to 0.895 (about 4 of 188 claims) without failing. Observed: recall@10=0.9160, recall@20=0.9479, nDCG@10=0.7976, MRR=0.7634. When a ranker change improves these, run `python evals/retrieval_eval.py --limit 0 --gate --ratchet` to raise the floors. This is also the bar hybrid retrieval and a reranker must beat.
